memory_candidates.content: When a plan's Phase 7/final gate step requires deploy-headless.sh / verify-deploy.sh / check-extension-docs.sh to pass cleanly in a multi-task /orchestrate cycle with declared concurrent siblings, a non-zero exit or FAIL summary is not automatically this task's regression. Always cross-reference every individual finding's file path against the dispatch's own territory.concurrent_siblings file_scope lists before treating it as a defect to fix. A finding naming a sibling's declared file is reported in the summary/deviations, never fixed -- fixing it would edit outside this task's own file_scope and could stomp a sibling's in-flight, uncommitted work.
